title: Unsolvable Problem Detection: Robust Understanding Evaluation for Large Multimodal Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (MM-UPD Bench) specifically designed to evaluate the robust understanding of Large Multimodal Models through tasks like Absent Answer Detection and Incompatible Visual Question Detection. The focus is on model reliability and understanding in technical and logic-based contexts; it does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
